# CLAIMs with `line` `records-of-inquiry`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**What a record of inquiry keeps** — what a record of a developing argument or inquiry can secure through revision — traceable change, accountability structure, decision sufficiency — and what keeping it buys beyond current conclusions; split from nucleating-argument (ADR-082).

| [CLAIM-294](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-294.md) v5 | Two inquiry histories can agree on every current conclusion and still call for different revisions of it, so a current marginal belief is not a sufficient state for updating on evidence about what it depended on | A5's central claim, made exact by A8's construction ([CASE-093](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-093.md)) and checked here.
